q2_gaps: a named recurring natural time-point NP as a temporal adjunct ("at the full moon"): the Time section licenses calendar/clock structured terms, deictic constants, day-part constants and fiscal periods, but nothing covers a natural recurrence, so whether it is a bare Time constant (as the parse has it), a compound kind needing its (Inheritance full_moon moon) genus, or an event-denoting sk_ entity is undetermined
